messages.english: Enter weekly harvest targets and your produce-pack weights in kilograms or pounds.
messages.translation: Faka izinhloso zokuvuna zamasonto onke nesisindo sakho samaphakethe ezivuno ngamakhilogremu (kg) noma ngamaphawundi esisindo (lb).

messages.english: Keep buyer entries when a save cannot be confirmed.
messages.translation: Gcina imininingwane yezidingo zabathengi oyifakile isekhona lapho ukulondolozwa kwayo kungakwazi ukuqinisekiswa.

messages.english: Choose kilograms or pounds, enter your harvest target or your own pack weight, then save. Unknown pack weights stay missing; target totals are planning estimates.
messages.translation: Khetha amakhilogremu (kg) noma amaphawundi esisindo (lb), faka inhloso yakho yokuvuna noma isisindo sakho sephakethe lesivuno, bese uyalondoloza. Isisindo samaphakethe esingaziwa sihlala singekho; izibalo zezinhloso zizilinganiso zokuhlela kuphela.
